description: Captures a save/load roundtrip starting from a scripted E1M1 state: save to slot 0, restart the engine, load slot 0, and assert the per-component state snapshot hashes (02-012) are identical pre-save and post-load. Save byte capture format (02-015) records the byte content and SHA-256. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: From 02-020 spawn, advance a deterministic ~140 tics, save to slot 0 via menu (key_menu_save = 60); kill DOOM.EXE; restart with -loadgame 0 or via menu (key_menu_load = 61); capture state before save, save bytes, and state after load.
